g.text: Predicting next year's health spending from this year's

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: MEPS Panel 28 adults 18–64 with private coverage in 2023 and 2024. Trained on 2,275 people, tested on 758 in 499 households. Lower loss is better; lines are 95% household-bootstrap intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: At the median, TabPFN v2 beats same as last year and age-sex group quantiles, is tied with gradient boosting (quantile) and linear quantile regression (tie = the 95% interval of the paired difference includes $0).
